svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of the Streets of Rage Project's development: the ROM is analysed, RageDecompiler transpiles the reachable code into C++ through a discovery loop, MegaDriveEnvironment supplies the hardware, routines are rewritten by hand, Genesis Plus GX renders the soundtrack, a symbolic AI plays through the controller, the game ships to Windows, macOS, Linux and the PS5, and four roadmap steps follow.
svg.title: From cartridge to C++

g.text: Builder · PS5 toolchain in a container

svg.text: 01 · A 512 KiB Mega Drive cartridge: your ROM, never patched.
02 · code-analysis/ guides the tools: labels, entry points, manual list.
03 · RageDecompiler transpiles only the code the game reaches.
04 · Exercise, record new addresses, recompile, play again.
05 · MegaDriveEnvironment supplies VDP, sound and pads.
06 · 100+ routines rewritten by hand; game state keeps its RAM address.
07 · Genesis Plus GX renders the soundtrack to FLAC.
08 · A symbolic AI reads RAM and plays through the pad.
09 · The Builder ships it; the PS5 toolchain is built in a container.
10 · Next: all C++, readable, no emulated hardware, then enhancements.
